ops.text: Fix round: fast_sidebar root cause was deeper than the gate showed — donor-only project.render made Quarto emit near-empty sidebars, so NO leaf page got injected (domdiff's first-line reporting masked it; harness hardened with region-presence checks). Fixed via per-donor file-args renders with full render globs: synthetic build now BYTE-EQUIVALENT to stock (45 pages, 0 diffs, 0 region mismatches); 173 tests green incl. new guard tests; commits 3c5de58 + 70f3737 (+ dfbc612 comment rewrite). P3 BLOCKER hit + decision: Quarto 1.9.38 has NO multi-input incremental render (extra args fall through to pandoc; single-file renders correct but 1.2s startup each; dir renders correct) — page-granular sharding is unimplementable without breaking cross-shard links. DECISION (fable): directory-granular sharding (quarto render <dir> per shard group + per-file root pages), land 3b-3f hardening, document the granularity limit citing quarto-cli#2749. Expected: honest D2 wall likely above the broken 297s; target metric internal<300s already met by fast_sidebar alone (176s internal).
